meta.name: GII GeM ERP Business Rules Repository
meta.description: Core business rules for Government e-Marketplace ERP system governing procurement, inventory, billing, payments, GST, banking, accounting, and compliance

rules.name: Invoice Requires Completed Delivery
rules.description: Invoice cannot be raised without delivered quantities
rules.condition: Invoice quantities must reference delivery challan or goods receipt note with status = 'Delivered'
exceptions: Advance payment invoices raised before delivery with CFO approval
rules.workflowImpact: Blocks invoice creation until delivery is confirmed in the system

rules.name: Order Requires Employee Assignment
rules.description: Every supply order must have an assigned employee
rules.condition: Supply order header.employeeId must be non-null and reference an active employee record
exceptions: System-generated auto-orders for indented stock transfers
rules.workflowImpact: Prevents order submission without responsible employee assignment

rules.name: Order Items Required
rules.description: Supply order must have at least one item before procurement-pending
rules.condition: Count of supplyOrder.lineItems >= 1 before status transitions to 'Procurement Pending'
rules.workflowImpact: Order cannot proceed to procurement stage without line items

rules.name: Procurement Requires Linked Order
rules.description: Every procurement must reference a valid supply order
rules.condition: procurement.orderId must reference an existing supplyOrder with status != 'Cancelled'
exceptions: Direct procurement for emergency purchases with management approval
rules.workflowImpact: Procurement creation blocked unless linked to a valid supply order

rules.name: Procurement Quantity Limit
rules.description: Procurement quantity cannot exceed order requirement unless authorized
rules.condition: SUM(procurement.lineItems.quantity) <= supplyOrder.lineItems.quantity for each item, OR authorized by officer rank >= Deputy Secretary
exceptions: Rate contract procurements with blanket order authorization
Emergency procurements with post-facto approval
rules.workflowImpact: Excess quantity requires authorization workflow with higher officer approval

rules.name: Stock Outward Requires Reservation
rules.description: Stock issue requires existing reservation or authorization
rules.condition: stockOutward.reservationId IS NOT NULL OR stockOutward.authorizationRef IS NOT NULL
exceptions: Direct material issues to production against production order
Sample issues below threshold value with storekeeper approval
rules.workflowImpact: Prevents unplanned stock removal without proper reservation or authorization

rules.name: Stock Adjustment Requires Approval
rules.description: Stock adjustments need maker-checker approval
rules.condition: stockAdjustment.status = 'Pending Approval' AND adjustment.createdBy != adjustment.approvedBy
exceptions: System-triggered adjustments from physical verification with negative variance below threshold
rules.workflowImpact: Adjustments enter approval queue; maker and checker must be different users

rules.name: Stock Valuation Uses Weighted Average
rules.description: Inventory valuation uses weighted average cost method
rules.condition: itemValuation.costMethod = 'WeightedAverage' AND valuation = (totalCost / totalQuantity)
exceptions: Specific identification method for serial-number-tracked high-value items
rules.workflowImpact: Valuation method is fixed for all inventory transactions

rules.name: Billing Requires Order Items
rules.description: Invoice must have at least one item row
rules.condition: COUNT(invoice.lineItems) >= 1
rules.workflowImpact: Invoice cannot be saved or posted without item details

rules.name: GST Type Must Match Place of Supply
rules.description: CGST/SGST for same state, IGST for different state
rules.condition: IF(placeOfSupply = companyState, taxType IN ('CGST','SGST'), taxType = 'IGST')
exceptions: SEZ supplies with zero-rated invoicing
rules.workflowImpact: Tax type auto-selected based on place of supply; manual override blocked

rules.name: Excess Billing Requires Authorization
rules.description: Billing above ordered quantity needs explicit reason
rules.condition: IF invoice.lineItems.quantity > salesOrder.lineItems.quantity THEN reasonCode IS NOT NULL AND authorizedBy IS NOT NULL
exceptions: Retention money release invoices
Price escalation clauses in contract
rules.workflowImpact: Excess billing flagged for review and requires authorized reason

rules.name: Payment Requires UTR
rules.description: Every receipt must have a unique UTR reference
rules.condition: receipt.utr IS NOT NULL AND receipt.utr IS UNIQUE IN receipt collection
exceptions: Cash receipts below threshold of INR 5,000
rules.workflowImpact: Receipt entry blocked without unique UTR; duplicate UTR flagged

rules.name: TDS Deduction Based on Threshold
rules.description: TDS deducted when invoice value exceeds threshold
rules.condition: IF invoice.totalValue >= sectionThreshold, TDS deducted at applicable section rate; ELSE no TDS
exceptions: Lower deduction certificate holder with valid certificate on file
rules.workflowImpact: TDS auto-calculated; threshold values maintained per financial year

rules.name: Receivable Requires Posted Invoice
rules.description: Receivable reports show only posted invoices
rules.condition: receivable.invoice.status = 'Posted'
rules.workflowImpact: Only posted invoices appear in ageing and outstanding reports

rules.name: Allocation Reduces Outstanding
rules.description: Unallocated payments do not reduce bill-wise outstanding
rules.condition: receiptAllocation.invoiceId IS NOT NULL AND receiptAllocation.allocatedAmount = receiptAllocation.amount
exceptions: On-account payments treated as advances without allocation
rules.workflowImpact: Outstanding reduced only when payment is allocated to specific invoice

rules.name: Payable Requires Posted Purchase
rules.description: Payable reports show only posted procurement
rules.condition: payable.procurement.status = 'Posted'
rules.workflowImpact: Only posted procurement reflected in payable ageing reports

rules.name: Supplier Payment Requires Bill Reference
rules.description: Payment must reference purchase bill for allocation
rules.condition: supplierPayment.billReference IS NOT NULL AND supplierPayment.allocationAmount <= billReference.pendingAmount
exceptions: Advance payments to suppliers against purchase orders
rules.workflowImpact: Payment must be allocated against specific purchase bills

rules.name: GST Register Based on Posted Vouchers
rules.description: GST reports use only posted voucher data
rules.condition: gstRegister.voucher.status = 'Posted' AND voucher.type IN ('SalesInvoice', 'PurchaseInvoice', 'CreditNote', 'DebitNote')
rules.workflowImpact: Draft/saved vouchers excluded from GST return computation

rules.name: Input GST Claim Requires Valid GSTIN
rules.description: Supplier must have valid GSTIN for input credit
rules.condition: supplier.gstin IS NOT NULL AND isValidGSTIN(supplier.gstin) = TRUE AND supplier.gstinStatus = 'Active'
exceptions: Composition scheme suppliers where reverse charge applies
Import of services under reverse charge mechanism
rules.workflowImpact: Input tax credit blocked for suppliers without valid registered GSTIN

rules.name: GST TDS Deduction Follows Section 194Q
rules.description: GST TDS deducted at 0.5% CGST + 0.5% SGST or 1% IGST
rules.condition: gstTds.taxType = IF(placeOfSupply = companyState, 'CGST+SGST', 'IGST') AND rate = IF(taxType='CGST+SGST', 0.005+0.005, 0.01)
exceptions: Supplies covered under TCS under GST Act
Supplies below threshold value specified in Section 194Q
rules.workflowImpact: GST TDS auto-calculated at prescribed rates; manual override prevented

rules.name: Bank Import Requires Statement Validation
rules.description: Imported rows must pass validation before approval
rules.condition: bankImport.rows ALL HAVING validationStatus = 'Passed'
exceptions: Rows with minor date mismatches can be force-approved by finance head
rules.workflowImpact: Import approval blocked until all rows pass validation checks

rules.name: Duplicate Bank Rows Blocked from Approval
rules.description: Potential duplicate entries are prevented from approval
rules.condition: bankImport.rows ALL HAVING duplicateScore < 0.8 (confidence threshold)
exceptions: Confirmed duplicate entries with supporting documentation
rules.workflowImpact: High-scoring potential duplicates flagged and blocked from approval

rules.name: Voucher Must Be Balanced
rules.description: Debit and credit totals must match before posting
rules.condition: SUM(voucher.entries.amount WHERE side = 'Debit') = SUM(voucher.entries.amount WHERE side = 'Credit')
rules.workflowImpact: Posting blocked for unbalanced vouchers; differential shown for correction

rules.name: Locked Financial Year Blocks Posting
rules.description: Closed years prevent new voucher posting
rules.condition: voucher.date WITHIN financialYear.openingDate AND financialYear.closingDate AND financialYear.status = 'Open'
exceptions: Prior period entries with authorized reopening of closed year
rules.workflowImpact: Posting prevented in locked financial years; reopening requires admin approval

rules.name: Reversal Requires Audit Reason
rules.description: Posted voucher reversal needs documented audit reason
rules.condition: reversal.auditReason IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(reversal.auditReason) >= 50
rules.workflowImpact: Reversal requires detailed reason; logged in audit trail

rules.name: Business Voucher Preferred Over Journal
rules.description: Use guided business vouchers, not manual journal, for routine transactions
rules.condition: transaction.type IN supportedBusinessVouchers IMPLIES journalEntry.type != 'Manual Journal'
exceptions: Rectification entries for previous period errors
Opening balance entries during implementation
rules.workflowImpact: System suggests appropriate business voucher; journal restricted to advanced users

rules.name: Reports Use Posted Data Only
rules.description: Financial reports show only posted ledger entries
rules.condition: report.dataSource FILTER entry.status = 'Posted'
exceptions: Draft report previews explicitly marked as 'Unposted Data Included'
rules.workflowImpact: Unposted transactions excluded from all financial reports by default

rules.name: Readiness Requires Zero Failed Checks
rules.description: Production readiness requires all checks passing
rules.condition: readiness.checkResults ALL HAVING status = 'Pass'
exceptions: Documented deviations with risk acceptance from Project Steering Committee
rules.workflowImpact: Go-live blocked until all readiness checks pass

rules.name: Environment Lock Prevents Dual Launch
rules.description: Only one environment can be production at a time
rules.condition: COUNT(environments WHERE role = 'Production') <= 1
exceptions: Disaster recovery failover with documented DR switch
rules.workflowImpact: Promoting an environment to production auto-demotes current production

rules.name: Go-Live Requires Admin Confirmation
rules.description: Production reset requires typed confirmation and admin role
rules.condition: resetAction.user.role = 'Administrator' AND resetAction.typedConfirmation = 'CONFIRM-RESET'
rules.workflowImpact: Reset action gated behind administrator role and explicit text confirmation

rules.name: Reset Preserves Configuration
rules.description: Operational reset must preserve master data and configuration
rules.condition: reset.scope IN ('TransactionalData', 'OperationalTransactions') AND masterData.status = 'Preserved' AND configuration.status = 'Preserved'
exceptions: Full system reset with explicit configuration reset flag and backup verification
rules.workflowImpact: Reset operation retains company setup, chart of accounts, item masters, user roles

rules.name: Company Context Required for Transactions
rules.description: Every transaction must reference current company
rules.condition: transaction.companyId IS NOT NULL AND transaction.companyId IN user.accessibleCompanies
rules.workflowImpact: All transactions scoped to active company context; cross-company visibility controlled

rules.name: No Direct Ledger Editing
rules.description: Ledger entries cannot be directly edited; use reversal workflow
rules.condition: ledgerEntry.updateAllowed = FALSE AND ledgerEntry.modificationMethod = 'ReversalOnly'
exceptions: System administrator data fix under documented change request
rules.workflowImpact: Ledger entries immutable after posting; corrections only via reversal + re-entry

rules.name: Audit Log for Critical Actions
rules.description: Create, edit, delete, post, reverse, import actions are logged
rules.condition: auditLog.actionType IN ('CREATE', 'EDIT', 'DELETE', 'POST', 'REVERSE', 'IMPORT') AND auditLog.timestamp IS NOT NULL AND auditLog.userId IS NOT NULL
rules.workflowImpact: All critical actions captured with user, timestamp, IP, and before-after snapshot

rules.name: Maker-Checker for Sensitive Actions
rules.description: Approval required for posting, reversal, adjustment, financial year close
rules.condition: sensitiveAction.creatorId != sensitiveAction.approverId AND sensitiveAction.status = 'Approved'
exceptions: System-generated automatic postings (e.g., depreciation, accruals)
rules.workflowImpact: Dual control enforced; same user cannot create and approve their own action

rules.name: Backup Before Restore
rules.description: Backup must be created before any restore operation
rules.condition: restoreOperation.preBackupId IS NOT NULL AND preBackup.verificationStatus = 'Verified'
rules.workflowImpact: Restore blocked unless verified backup exists from current state

rules.name: Financial Year Sequential
rules.description: Vouchers must use dates within open financial year
rules.condition: voucher.date >= financialYear.startDate AND voucher.date <= financialYear.endDate
exceptions: Prior period adjustment vouchers in reopened years with admin authorization
rules.workflowImpact: Voucher date restricted to current open financial year range

rules.name: Party Ledger Reconciliation Required
rules.description: Party ledgers must reconcile with control accounts
rules.condition: ABS(SUM(partyLedger.balance) - controlAccount.balance) <= reconciliationTolerance AND reconciliationDate IS NOT NULL
exceptions: Inter-unit transactions pending cross-entity confirmation
rules.workflowImpact: Period-end reconciliation mandatory; unreconciled difference flagged for review

rules.name: Serial Number Tracking for Tracked Items
rules.description: Serial/batch numbers required for tracked items
rules.condition: item.serialTracking = TRUE IMPLIES transaction.lineItem.serialNumber IS NOT NULL; item.batchTracking = TRUE IMPLIES transaction.lineItem.batchNumber IS NOT NULL
exceptions: Bulk consumables with no tracking requirement defined in item master
rules.workflowImpact: Serial/batch fields mandatory for tracked items in all inward and outward transactions

rules.name: Document Readiness Before Billing
rules.description: Required documents must be attached before billing completion
rules.condition: billing.requiredDocuments ALL HAVING attachmentId IS NOT NULL AND attachment.status = 'Verified'
exceptions: Provisional billing with government undertaking for pending documents
rules.workflowImpact: Billing completion blocked until all mandatory documents are attached and verified
